title: Lutchen's and playing two numbers then resting
summary: Ferbos explains that bands played a few numbers then paused so patrons would drink; they talk about Lutchen's.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

I remember at Lutchen's they'd play two numbers and then the band would just sit there for a while and everybody would drink that beer. And they'd play two numbers and everybody would dance. That's right. They always want you to do that?

And so the manager didn't want you to drink that. Yeah that's right.
